records.title: ART: Attention Run-time Termination for Efficient Large Language Model Decoding
records.reason: ART terminates redundant attention/KV blocks at decode time and reports throughput improvement; direct LLM decoding acceleration.

records.title: PromptDistill: Query-based Selective Token Retention in Intermediate Layers for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
records.reason: PromptDistill dynamically retains salient intermediate tokens without training to reduce LLM inference computation.

records.title: DiRL: An Efficient Post-Training Framework for Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: DiRL combines diffusion-LLM post-training with FlexAttention and an LMDeploy-optimized inference route; the abstract explicitly connects training framework and efficient inference.

records.title: RSAVQ: Riemannian Sensitivity-Aware Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
records.reason: RSAVQ applies sensitivity-aware vector quantization to LLM weights for smaller, deployable models; direct post-training compression.

records.title: Boost Post-Training Quantization via Null Space Optimization for Large Language Models
records.reason: Null-space optimization improves post-training LLM quantization while avoiding added inference-time overhead.

records.title: Attention Editing: A Versatile Framework for Cross-Architecture Attention Conversion
records.reason: Attention Editing converts attention layers toward MLA/sliding-window structures for reduced KV-cache memory and efficient attention.

records.title: Language Models Need Sleep: Learning to Self-Modify and Consolidate Memories
records.reason: The primary abstract is about continual learning, distilling short-term knowledge into parameters, and RL-driven self-improvement. It does not describe serving, decoding, inference efficiency, or inference-state compression.

records.title: LoPA: Scaling dLLM Inference via Lookahead Parallel Decoding
records.reason: LoPA uses lookahead parallel decoding for diffusion LLMs and targets higher multi-device inference throughput.

records.title: HSR-Enhanced Sparse Attention Acceleration
records.reason: HSR-Enhanced Sparse Attention targets faster Transformer/LLM prefill and decode through sparse attention acceleration.

records.title: Do Value Vectors in Deep Layers Need Context from the Residual Stream?
records.reason: The abstract proposes context-free value-vector lookups to avoid repeated computation and cache storage in deep layers; this is a concrete compute/memory optimization for Transformer inference.

records.title: Multi-Drafter Speculative Decoding with Alignment Feedback
records.reason: Multi-Drafter speculative decoding combines multiple drafts with alignment feedback and dynamic computation allocation to improve inference decoding.

records.title: Hot–Cold Tiering of HBM and High Bandwidth Flash for Agentic LLM Serving
records.reason: Hot/cold HBM/HBF tiering moves KV state across memory tiers for agentic LLM serving, increasing concurrent sessions per GPU.

records.title: Scalable Sparse Transformer Accelerator With In-Memory Butterfly Zero Skipper and Local Attention Reusable Engine for Semi-Structured-Pruned NN
records.reason: The stable DOI and exact title are in the pinned worklist. Official IEEE DOI/Xplore could not be opened (non-retryable internal error); other accessible catalogues were secondary and not used for abstract classification. Retain as source-unavailable borderline.

records.title: CCQ: Convolutional Code for Extreme Low-bit Quantization in LLMs
records.reason: CCQ uses convolutional coding for extreme low-bit LLM quantization, reducing model memory while preserving inference quality.

records.title: Cloud-Based Large Language Model Deployment: A Comparative Analysis of Serverless and Bring-Your-Own-Container Architectures
records.reason: The official journal publisher PDF compares serverless and BYOC LLM deployments across inference cost, availability, and observability; it identifies system trade-offs relevant to production LLM serving.

records.title: Role-Based Fault Tolerance System for LLM RL Post-Training
records.reason: The abstract targets an RL post-training system that interleaves training and inference, isolates trainer/rollout failures, and avoids full restart/replay overhead; it reports improved effective training-time ratio and end-to-end time.

records.title: Tensor Memory: Fixed-Size Recurrent State for Long-Horizon Transformers
records.reason: The primary abstract proposes a fixed-size recurrent 3D state mainly for long-horizon video/spatial reasoning. It notes KV-cache state growth and benchmarks language/image/video, but does not establish an LLM inference-efficiency benefit; retain as a weakly connected borderline.

records.title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
records.reason: QATFactory aligns quantization-aware training/distillation with deployment engines and exports quantized LLMs for efficient production inference.

records.title: Advancing Decoding Strategies: Enhancements in Locally Typical Sampling for LLMs
records.reason: The abstract proposes an adaptive LLM decoding/sampling algorithm and explicitly frames computational efficiency alongside generation quality; direct decoding-method connection, though system-speed evidence is limited.

records.title: BitStack: Any-Size Compression of Large Language Models in Variable Memory Environments
records.reason: The arXiv page confirms DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2410.23918 and the current primary title “BitStack: Any-Size Compression of Large Language Models in Variable Memory Environments” (the worklist title differs). Its abstract describes training-free, dynamically adjustable weight compression for variable-memory deployment.
